summary: Added fees $45-55 (none stored), season May 1-Oct 25, sewer, showers/laundry/dump, weekend + holiday minimums. Booking platform roverpass->operator (RoverPass unclaimed). Note cleaned. Nightly share about 1 in 4.
flags: GATE FACTS: cheapest RV night $45 Monday-Wednesday; Thursday-Sunday $55 (operator's 2026 chart), plus 7% tax. Passes on the weeknight, but the weekend rate is over $50. No gateway within 40 km (Indiana Dunes NP 64 km). Good Sam stored false. Family has not stayed. Presence: working site, phone/text 574-784-8532.

GOOGLE: 4.5 stars, 328 reviews. Mostly warm; one so-so, 3 months ago: 'Nice area, facilities were clean. Would not stay again due to small and unlevel site. not big rig friendly or in person. Mostly a local camping area.'

LONG-STAY: test 4 passes. Counting the 2024 map's colours: nightly about 31 (20 pull-throughs 400-419, 11 electric-only 700-710), monthly about 22, seasonal about 80, so roughly 23% nightly. It leads with 'Nightly * Weekly * Monthly * Seasonal'; monthly sites are 'for full-timers'. I read it as a seasonal-heavy park with a real nightly section, not mostly seasonal. Seasonal $2,500, monthly $750. Age rules (10-15 years) apply to long-term leases only.

ROVERPASS: stored platform was roverpass. The listing is UNCLAIMED ('Claim my Campground', 'Last Updated: 11/15/2024'). The operator takes reservations by its own form, phone or text. No online engine, but a posted rate.
WATER: 'not waterfront' stands. Only the 11 electric-only 700s are 'near the new fishing pond', a small private pond; the 400s are not near water. A larger marsh/lake is off the property to the west.
PIN: 41.5397,-86.2924 is at the Maple Road entrance, about 100-150 m from the sites' centre, fine.
